auth.login.heading: Sign in to UBOSS Admin
auth.login.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of use

auth.forgot.heading: Reset your password
auth.forgot.intro: We will email you a link to choose a new one.
auth.forgot.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.forgot.sentBody: If that address belongs to a staff account, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for a limited time.
auth.forgot.sentSpam: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder before asking for another.
auth.reset.heading: Choose a new password
auth.reset.intro: You will sign in with this straight afterwards.
auth.reset.failed: The password could not be reset.
auth.reset.tokenExpired: This reset link has expired. Reset links are short-lived for security - request a new one.
auth.reset.tokenUsed: This reset link has already been used. If it was not you, request a new one and sign in straight away.
auth.reset.tokenInvalid: This reset link is not valid. Try opening it directly from the email rather than pasting it.
auth.reset.tokenUnknown: We could not reset your password. Please request a new link.
auth.change.heading: Choose your own password
auth.change.intro: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own before continuing.
auth.change.failed: The password could not be changed.
auth.forgot.enterAddress: Enter the address you sign in with and we will email you a link.
auth.forgot.sentBodyAdmin: If that address belongs to a staff account, a reset link is on its way. It expires in an hour, so use it soon.
auth.forgot.sentSpamAdmin: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder before asking for another. If you have never signed in, ask a Business Owner to resend your temporary password instead.
auth.forgot.sendFailed: We could not send the link. Please try again.
auth.reset.onlyYouKnow: Only you will know it — nobody at UBOSS can see or set it.
auth.reset.doneBody: Sign in with it. Any other session you had open has been signed out.
auth.reset.noToken: No reset token was found in the link.
auth.reset.setFailed: The password could not be set.
auth.reset.expiredBody: Reset links last an hour, because a live one sitting in an inbox is a key to the account. Ask for a fresh one and it will arrive within a few minutes.
auth.reset.usedTitleAdmin: This link has already been used
auth.reset.usedBodyAdmin: Your password is already set. Sign in with it — or ask for another link if you cannot remember what you chose.
auth.reset.invalidTitleAdmin: This reset link is not valid
auth.reset.invalidBodyAdmin: The link may have been copied incompletely. Try opening it straight from the email rather than pasting it.
auth.reset.deactivatedTitle: This account is no longer active
auth.reset.deactivatedBody: Ask a Business Owner to reactivate it from Staff before resetting the password.
auth.reset.unknownTitle: We could not set your password
auth.reset.unknownBody: Something went wrong at our end. Asking for a new link is usually the quickest way through.
auth.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A short phrase you will remember beats a short jumble you will not.
auth.change.introAdmin: You signed in with the temporary password we emailed
auth.change.temporaryPasswordHint: The one from the email. It stops working as soon as you finish here.
auth.change.temporaryPasswordRequired: Enter the temporary password from your email.
auth.change.mustDiffer: Choose something different from the temporary password.
auth.change.nobodyElseKnows: Nobody else knows this one — not even whoever set your account up.
auth.change.setFailed: We could not set your password. Please try again.
auth.location.heading: Allow location access
auth.location.intro: This panel records where each sign-in happens. Share this device's location to continue.
auth.location.prompt: Your browser will ask for permission. Choose Allow.
auth.location.denied: Location access is blocked for this site. Allow it in your browser's site settings, then try again.
auth.location.unavailable: Your device could not work out where it is. Check that location services are switched on, then try again.
auth.location.timedOut: Your device took too long to answer. Try again.
auth.location.unsupported: This browser cannot share a location with the panel. That usually means the panel is not served over HTTPS — ask whoever runs this installation to enable it, or to switch the requirement off.
auth.location.failed: Your location could not be recorded. Try again.
auth.location.why: Everyone who can read staff records is told which place each sign-in came from, so a sign-in nobody made gets noticed.

auth.mfa.enrolIntro: Add this administrator account to an authenticator app before you continue.
auth.mfa.challengeIntro: Enter the current code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
auth.mfa.scanHeading: Scan this with your authenticator app
auth.mfa.scanBody: Open your authenticator app, choose to add an account, and point the camera at this code.
auth.mfa.appHint: Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password and Authy all work.
auth.mfa.scanReload: Leaving or reloading this page issues a new code, and the one you scanned stops working. Finish the setup in one go.
auth.mfa.keyBody: In your authenticator app, choose to enter a setup key by hand. The account type is time based.
auth.mfa.recoveryBody: Save these somewhere separate and secure. They are shown once, and each one can be used once if you lose your phone.
auth.mfa.recoverySaved: I have saved the recovery codes somewhere secure.
auth.mfa.setupFailed: Two-step sign-in setup could not be started.
auth.mfa.verifyFailed: The code could not be checked.

productDetail.name: Name
productDetail.uniqueAcrossProductsAndVar: Unique across products and variants alike.
productDetail.leaveBlankToGenerateIt: Leave blank to generate it from the name.
productDetail.ordersMustBeAMultiple: Orders must be a multiple of this.
productDetail.publicationNeedsAtLeastOne: Publication needs at least one image. The first is the one customers see in listings.
productDetail.aProductCannotBePublished: A product cannot be published without at least one. The first image is what customers see in listings.
productDetail.enforcedOnEveryCartChange: Enforced on every cart change and again at checkout, so a customer cannot get round them by editing the cart.
productDetail.offMeansTheProductIs: Off means the product is always orderable and Inventory ignores it.
productDetail.customersCanPutItOn: Customers can put it on a standing schedule. This only decides anything where the store curates which products may be repeated; by default every product can be.
productDetail.imagesUploadOnCreate: Chosen now, uploaded the moment the product is created. The first image is the one customers see in listings.
productDetail.orAddThemAfterCreating: A product cannot be published without at least one. You can also add them after creating it.
productDetail.notAnImageFile: Skipped {{names}} - only JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF images can be added.
productDetail.aNewProductStartsAs: A new product starts as a draft. Create it first, then publish.
productDetail.aProductReachesCustomersOn: A product reaches customers only when it is
productDetail.activeInTheCatalogueAnd: Active in the catalogue and Published here.
productDetail.unpublishingRemovesItFromT: Unpublishing removes it from the storefront immediately. Orders that already include it are unaffected.
productDetail.archivingRemovesTheProduct: Archiving removes the product from the catalogue and the storefront. Existing orders keep it, so history stays readable.
settings.name: Name
settings.useAsTheDefaultFor: Use as the default for new products
marketplace.heading: Marketplace commission
marketplace.panelDescription: What this business keeps when a seller makes a sale.
marketplace.standardCommissionHint: Between 0 and 100. Type 2.5 for two and a half per cent.
marketplace.commissionExplainer: Taken from the goods only — never from tax, which is money on its way to a tax authority, and never from delivery, which is recovery of a cost. A seller can be put on a rate of their own from their page under Sellers, and that rate wins over this one.
marketplace.commissionNotRetroactive: Changing this applies to orders confirmed from now on. Each seller’s share of an order keeps the rate that applied when it was confirmed, so no statement already sent can move.
marketplace.commissionSaveFailed: The commission rate could not be saved.
settings.howTheBusinessNamesItself: How the business names itself to customers and on paper.
settings.theRegisteredEntityUsedOn: The registered entity, used on invoices.
settings.whatCustomersSeeOnThe: What customers see on the storefront and in emails.
settings.ianaNameEGAsia: IANA name, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Recurring schedules run on this clock.
settings.whereCustomersAreToldTo: Where customers are told to write when something goes wrong.
settings.prefixesApplyToNumbersIssued: Prefixes apply to numbers issued from now on. Numbers already assigned keep the prefix they were issued with.
settings.appearsOnInvoicesEmailsAnd: Appears on invoices, emails and the customer site.
settings.everyProductCarriesExactlyOne: Every product carries exactly one tax class.
settings.anInactiveClassCannotBe: An inactive class cannot be chosen for new products. Products already on it are unaffected.
settings.exactlyOneIsTheDefault: Exactly one is the default, and every product carries one. Changing a rate applies to new orders — orders already placed keep the tax they were charged.
settings.wholePartsOfTheSystem: Whole parts of the system, on or off. Turning one on is immediate and harmless; turning one off can stop work that is already in flight, so it asks what that would cost first.
settings.businessIdentityTaxAndWhat: Business identity, tax, and what the system does. Three panels, each with a rule the server enforces whatever this screen shows.
settings.youCanReadTheseSettings: You can read these settings but not change them. The fields are shown as they stand.
settings.fixedOnceAnyOrderExists: Fixed once any order exists. Every stored amount is minor units of this currency, so changing the label would silently reprice all of history.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.howThisConnectionIsListed: How this connection is listed here, e.g. “Razorpay sandbox”.
integrations.encryptedBeforeStorageAndNe: Encrypted before storage and never sent back to this screen.
integrations.fromTheGatewayDashboardWith: From the gateway dashboard. Without it, no incoming payment event can be verified — and an unverified event is never applied, so no order would ever be confirmed by a payment.
integrations.savingAlwaysDeactivatesTheC: Saving always deactivates the connection until it passes a test.
integrations.activateOneConnectionPer: Activate one connection per gateway. Customers choose between the active gateways at checkout, and cannot pay until at least one is connected, tested and activated.
integrations.startInTestModeNo: Start in Test mode — no real money can move on a test key, and the same three steps apply.
integrations.paymentGatewayCredentialsAn: Payment gateway credentials and third-party connectors. Secrets are encrypted before storage and never sent back to this screen.
integrations.testNoRealMoneyCan: Test — no real money can move
integrations.onceThisConnectionIsActivat: Once this connection is activated, customer checkouts charge real cards and refunds move real money. Use Test mode for anything that is not production.
integrations.withoutAWebhookSecretNo: Without a webhook secret, no incoming payment event can be verified — so no order will ever be confirmed by a payment.
integrations.activationNeedsAPassingTest: Activation needs a passing test — enforced by the server, not just by this button.
integrations.customerCheckoutsWillCharge: Customer checkouts will charge real cards and refunds will move real money.
integrations.otherGatewaysOnLive: Other gateways on live keys stay active — customers choose between them at checkout. Any gateway still on test keys is switched off.
integrations.thisIsATestConnection: This is a test connection. No real money can move on a test key.
integrations.otherGatewaysOnTest: Other gateways on test keys stay active — customers choose between them at checkout. Any gateway on live keys is switched off.
orderDetail.optionalRecordedWithTheDecis: Optional. Recorded with the decision, either way.
orderDetail.staffOnlyCustomersNeverSee: Staff only. Customers never see this.
orderDetail.thisOrderExceedsTheCustomer: This order exceeds the customer's approval threshold and will not move until somebody decides.
orderDetail.everyStatusChangeWithWho: Every status change, with who made it and why.
orderDetail.reportedNeverEditedOnlyA: Reported, never edited. Only a verified gateway event settles an order.
orderDetail.anyReservedStockGoesBack: Any reserved stock goes back to available. If the order has been paid, refund it separately from the Payments panel.
orderDetail.aFinanceApproverOrBusiness: A Finance Approver or Business Owner has to decide this one.
orderDetail.nothingCanMoveFromHere: Nothing can move from here. This is a final state, or the next step belongs to the system.
coupons.generatedForYouChangeIt: Generated for you. Change it if you would rather.
coupons.shownHereNeverToA: Shown here, never to a customer.
coupons.appearsBesideTheCodeIn: Appears beside the code in the storefront's coupon list.
coupons.aDraftCouponNeverMatches: A draft coupon never matches, whatever else is set here.
coupons.productsInTheseCategoriesAnd: Products in these categories, and everything beneath them, get the discount. Hold Ctrl (or Cmd) to choose more than one.
coupons.setPerCurrencyBecauseA: Set per currency, because a threshold converted between currencies would move with the exchange rate. Leave one blank and the coupon does not apply in that market at all — at least one is required.
coupons.percentageDiscountsOptionallyLim: Percentage discounts, optionally limited to categories, that unlock at a cart value set per currency.
coupons.theCodeIsWhatA: The code is what a customer types. Everything else decides when it applies.
coupons.offMakesItCodeOnly: Off makes it code-only: it still works when typed, it is just not listed.
customerDetail.countsOnlyOrdersPlacedIn: Counts only orders placed in this currency. Blank means no cap.
customerDetail.agreedTermsPerMarketA: Agreed terms per market. A currency with no terms is one this account cannot order in at all.
customerDetail.appliesToTheWholeAccount: Applies to the whole account. The value that triggers it is set per currency below — leave that blank and every order needs approving.
customerDetail.usedAtCheckoutForBilling: Used at checkout for billing and delivery.
customerDetail.theCustomerAddsOneAt: The customer adds one at checkout. Nothing here can add one for them.
customerDetail.staffOnlyTheCustomerNever: Staff only. The customer never sees this.
customerDetail.noneYetThisAccountCannot: None yet — this account cannot order in any currency.
customerDetail.thisAccountHasNotBeen: This account has not been activated. The customer sets their own password from the invitation — nobody here can set it for them.
dashboard.shareOfOrders: Share of the {{count}} orders in this period
dashboard.salesOrdersAndAnythingThat: Sales, orders and anything that needs attention.
dashboard.whereEveryOrderInThis: Where every order in this period currently sits. Open a row to work that status.
dashboard.everyTransactionRaisedInThis: Every transaction raised in this period, by the state it stopped in.
dashboard.theNextScheduledRunFor: The next scheduled run for each active schedule, over the coming week.
dashboard.noActiveScheduleHasARun: No active schedule has a run due.
dashboard.lowStockThreshold: Available quantity at or below the reorder threshold.
dashboard.lowStockAtThreshold_one: {{products}} product at or below the reorder threshold.
dashboard.lowStockAtThreshold_other: {{products}} products at or below the reorder threshold.
dashboard.lowStockAtThresholdShown_one: {{products}} product at or below the reorder threshold, showing the first {{shown}}.
dashboard.lowStockAtThresholdShown_other: {{products}} products at or below the reorder threshold, showing the first {{shown}}.
dashboard.stoppedSchedules_one: Paused or failed after repeated errors. {{occurrences}} occurrence has failed in total.
dashboard.stoppedSchedules_other: Paused or failed after repeated errors. {{occurrences}} occurrences have failed in total.
staff.twoRulesThisScreenCannot: Two rules this screen cannot break
staff.aOneTimePasswordIs: A one-time password is emailed here, good for 72 hours. Signing in with it forces them to choose their own — which nobody else, including you, ever sees.
staff.aRoleIsASet: A role is a set of permissions. Give the narrowest set that does the job.
staff.anAccountWithNoRoles: An account with no roles can sign in and see nothing, so at least one is required.
staff.whoCanSignInAnd: Who can sign in, and what each of them may do. Nobody here is given a password — an account is emailed a one-time credential and chooses its own.
staff.youCannotGrantOrRemove: You cannot grant or remove that role, so it is left unchanged.
staff.anAccountNeedsAtLeast: An account needs at least one role. Deactivate it instead if it should have no access.
reports.csvGeneratedInTheBackground: CSV, generated in the background. A large export does not hold up this page, and the list refreshes itself while one is running.
reports.orderedCollectedAndRefundedKept: Ordered, collected and refunded — kept separate, because they are different numbers.
reports.everyOrderPlacedInThe: Every order placed in the period.
reports.howLongConfirmedOrdersHave: How long confirmed orders have been waiting to ship.
payments.recordedAgainstYourNameAnd: Recorded against your name and sent to the gateway.
payments.theGatewayProcessesThisIt: The gateway processes this. It cannot be undone from here.
payments.aGatewayEventOnlyCounts: A gateway event only counts once its signature verifies. Nothing from a rejected delivery is ever applied.
payments.whatTheGatewayConfirmedThis: What the gateway confirmed. This screen reports money and issues refunds; nothing here marks an order paid by hand.
categories.name: Name
categories.theUrlSegmentCustomersSee: The URL segment customers see. Leave blank to generate it from the name.
categories.aCategoryCannotBeMoved: A category cannot be moved beneath itself, so its own branch is not offered.
categories.lowerNumbersComeFirstAmong: Lower numbers come first among siblings.
categories.slugIsGeneratedFromThe: Slug is generated from the name when left blank.
categories.anInactiveCategoryIsHidden: An inactive category is hidden from the customer site. Products in it keep their category.
categories.theTreeCustomersBrowseOrder: The tree customers browse. Order here is the order they see, and a category has to be active before anything in it can reach the storefront.
categories.anArchivedCategoryDisappearsF: An archived category disappears from the customer site. Products already in it keep their history and are not deleted.
customers.theAccountIsCreatedHere: The account is created here; the customer activates it from the invitation.
customers.theCustomerSetsTheirOwn: The customer sets their own password from the link. Nobody here types it for them, and until they accept it the account cannot sign in.
customers.businessAccountsCreatedHereAct: Business accounts. Staff create and invite them here; where self-registration is on, accounts that signed up on the website arrive under Awaiting approval.
inventory.purchaseOrderDeliveryNoteOr: Purchase order, delivery note or invoice number.
inventory.negativeToRemoveStockPositive: Negative to remove stock, positive to add it. Use a receipt for deliveries — the ledger keeps corrections and arrivals apart.
inventory.recordedInTheLedgerAgainst: Recorded in the ledger against your name, permanently. Be specific.
inventory.onHandIsWhatExists: On hand is what exists. Available is what a customer can buy — on hand less whatever carts and unpaid orders have already reserved.
inventory.everyChangeToStockWith: Every change to stock, with who made it and why. Append-only — the twenty-five most recent.
products.aProductReachesCustomersOnly: A product reaches customers only when it is both Active in the catalogue and published to the storefront.
bulkPricing.title: Price the catalogue in another currency
bulkPricing.description: Converts every {{base}} price into the currency you choose and stores the result. Prices do not track the rate afterwards — they are ordinary prices you can edit per product.
bulkPricing.noCurrencyBody: Activate the currency you want to sell in first, in Settings. Only then can its prices be filled in.
bulkPricing.targetHintPriced: Some products are already priced in {{currency}}. Those are left alone unless you say otherwise below.
bulkPricing.targetHintEmpty: Nothing is priced in {{currency}} yet, so this market is currently invisible to shoppers.
bulkPricing.rateHint: An exact decimal, e.g. 0.0105. Used once, now — it is not stored and prices will not follow it later.
bulkPricing.rateHintLive: Today rate, fetched just now. Used once, on write — prices will not follow it later unless you leave automatic updates on below.
bulkPricing.roundingHint: Converted figures always round up, never down.
bulkPricing.roundingWhole: Round up to a whole unit (45.30 → 46.00)
bulkPricing.overwriteLabel: Replace prices already entered in this currency
bulkPricing.overwriteHint: Off by default. A price somebody set by hand for this market is a deliberate local price, and a conversion should not undo it.
bulkPricing.failedBody: That could not be run. Check the connection and try again.
bulkPricing.summary_one: {{count}} price will be written in {{target}}, from {{scanned}} priced in {{source}}.
bulkPricing.summary_other: {{count}} prices will be written in {{target}}, from {{scanned}} priced in {{source}}.
bulkPricing.summarySkipped_one: {{count}} is already priced and left alone.
bulkPricing.summarySkipped_other: {{count}} are already priced and left alone.
bulkPricing.lifted_one: {{count}} price converted to less than one {{currency}} minor unit and was lifted to the smallest amount possible. That usually means the decimal point is in the wrong place.
bulkPricing.lifted_other: {{count}} prices converted to less than one {{currency}} minor unit and were lifted to the smallest amount possible. That usually means the decimal point is in the wrong place.
bulkPricing.nothingToWrite: Nothing to write. Every product is already priced in {{currency}}.
bulkPricing.nothingToWriteOverwriteOff: Nothing to write. Every product is already priced in {{currency}}, and replacing existing prices is switched off.
bulkPricing.showingFirst: Showing the first {{shown}}. The remaining {{rest}} are converted the same way.
policyLinks.title: Policy links
policyLinks.description: The terms, privacy and returns pages this business publishes.
policyLinks.howItWorks: These appear in the storefront footer and beside the terms tick on both sign-in screens. The labels you set here are the labels people see, in this order. Nothing is built in — set none, and no links appear.
policyLinks.none: No links yet. Add one and it appears in the storefront footer and beside the terms tick at sign-in.
policyLinks.labelHint: What the link is called, e.g. Terms of business.
policyLinks.urlHint: Must start with http:// or https://
policyLinks.saveFailed: The policy links could not be saved.
policyLinks.urlRequired: Enter the address this link points at.
policyLinks.urlNotHttp: The address must start with http:// or https://
policyLinks.duplicateLabel: Two links cannot share a label — the second would replace the first.
exchangeRates.title: Automatic exchange rate updates
exchangeRates.description: Keeps converted prices current without ever converting at checkout.
exchangeRates.howItWorks: The storefront never converts a price when a page loads — it quotes a stored figure, so a shopper is charged exactly what they saw. This refreshes those stored figures once a day, for every market you filled in from Products → Currency pricing. A price you edit by hand stops being refreshed from that moment on.
exchangeRates.enableHint: Off until you turn it on. While off, no rates are fetched and nothing is rewritten.
exchangeRates.marginHint: Added to the mid-market rate, as a buffer against it moving before the next run. 0 quotes the rate exactly.
exchangeRates.roundingHint: Converted figures always round up, never down.
exchangeRates.driftHint: If any single price would move by more than this, the whole run is abandoned and nothing is written. Guards against a bad rate feed.
exchangeRates.saveFailed: Those settings could not be saved.
exchangeRates.runFailed: The refresh could not be completed.
catalogueTranslation.title: Catalogue translation
catalogueTranslation.description: Translate your own product names and descriptions into every language the storefront offers.
catalogueTranslation.howItWorks: The interface ships translated; your products do not, because only you know what you sell. This sends product and category copy to DeepL and stores the result per language. SKUs, slugs and variant names are never translated — they are identifiers, not words. Anything you edit and mark as reviewed is never overwritten.
catalogueTranslation.keyHint: A free key covers a catalogue this size. Stored encrypted; only its last four characters are ever shown again.
catalogueTranslation.keyStored: A key ending {{hint}} is stored. Enter a new one to replace it.
catalogueTranslation.keyFailed: That key could not be saved.
catalogueTranslation.allTranslated: Every product and category is translated into all seven languages.
catalogueTranslation.estimateBody: {{rows}} rows, {{characters}} characters. DeepL bills per character, and a free key allows 500,000 a month.
catalogueTranslation.runFailed: The translation could not be completed.
bulkPricing.autoManagedLabel: Keep these prices up to date automatically
bulkPricing.autoManagedHint: Refreshes them daily from the exchange rate, once automatic updates are switched on in Settings. Any price you later edit by hand drops out of the refresh.
variants.name: Name
variants.sharesOneNamespaceWithProduct: Shares one namespace with product SKUs.
variants.leaveThePriceBlankTo: Leave the price blank to inherit the product's base price.
variants.separatelyStockedAndPricedForms: Separately stocked and priced forms of this product.
variants.itHasNeverBeenOrdered: It has never been ordered and holds no stock, so it will be deleted outright rather than left in the picker.
productImport.theFileCouldNotBe: The file could not be read
productImport.uploadASpreadsheetToCreate: Upload a spreadsheet to create and update products. Nothing changes until you confirm — and import never deletes and never publishes.
productImport.csvOnlyUtf8Every: CSV only (UTF-8). Every spreadsheet exports it — in Excel, choose Save As → CSV UTF-8. An .xlsx file is refused rather than mis-read.
productImport.theUploadValidatesEveryRow: The upload validates every row and writes nothing. A SKU that already exists is an update; a new one is a create.
productImport.leaveThisUntickedToFix: Leave this unticked to fix the file and upload it again instead — which is usually the right answer.
productImport.importedProductsAreNotPubl: Imported products are not published. Publish them individually when they are ready for customers.
chatEnquiries.transcriptDescription: What was asked and what the assistant answered. The contact details come from the account, except on older rows marked unverified.
chatEnquiries.pageDescription: Customers who used the storefront chat. The assistant is for signed-in customers, so a row is normally tied to an account; older rows from when anyone could chat carry self-declared details and are marked as such.
chatEnquiries.name: Name
chatEnquiries.unverifiedDetails: These details were typed into the old chat form and were never verified. Treat them as a claim, not as an identity.
recurring.schedulesThatPlaceOrdersOn: Schedules that place orders on their own. Times are the customer's local wall clock, not yours.
ordersList.fulfilmentAndPaymentAreSepara: Fulfilment and payment are separate columns because they move separately. Total is what was ordered; paid is what actually arrived.
audit.whoChangedWhatWhenAnd: Who changed what, when, and from where. Append-only — nothing on this screen can edit or remove an entry.
dataRequests.title: Data subject requests
dataRequests.description: Requests to see or erase personal data, ordered by legal deadline. The GDPR allows one month from receipt.
dataRequests.subject: Subject
dataRequests.overdueBody: {{count}} request(s) on this page are past the one month the GDPR allows. Answer them today.
dataRequests.emptyDescription: Requests appear here when a customer asks for a copy of their data or asks to be erased.
dataRequests.approved: Approved. The work has been queued.
dataRequests.rejected: Refused. The subject has been told why.
dataRequests.decisionFailed: That decision could not be recorded.
dataRequests.irreversibleBody: The account will be anonymised: contact details, addresses, carts, sessions and chat enquiries are deleted. Invoiced orders are kept, as tax law requires, but will no longer name the customer.
dataRequests.blockedTitle: This account cannot be erased yet
dataRequests.reasonPlaceholder: Explain which exemption applies, in plain language.
dataRequests.notePlaceholder: For your colleagues. Not sent to the customer.
dataRequests.reasonIsSentToSubject: This text is emailed to the customer, along with a reminder that they may complain to a data protection authority.
specifications.shownOnTheProductPage: Shown on the product page, in this order. Nothing here changes the price or how much a customer may buy.
currencyPrices.aRealPricePerMarket: A real price per market, never a conversion. Leave one blank and the product is not sold there.
market.nonePricedIn: Nothing on this page is priced in {{currency}}, so no customer price is shown.
guards.youDoNotHaveAccess: You do not have access to this page
guards.yourAccountDoesNotInclude: Your account does not include the permissions this screen needs. A Business Owner can change that from Staff.
errorBoundary.heading: This page stopped working
errorBoundary.body: Nothing you were doing has been saved. Reloading usually clears it.
translations.heading: Translations
translations.saveFirst: Save this record first, then its translations can be edited.
translations.name: Name
translations.saveFailed: The translation could not be saved.
translations.cleared: Translation cleared. This language now shows the source text.
translations.emptyFallsBack: An empty field falls back to the source text.
translations.uncheckedNotice: This was machine-translated and nobody has checked it. Saving marks it as checked.
settings.taxRegistrationHint: Your national tax registration, printed on every invoice — GSTIN in India, ABN in Australia, EIN in the United States, or the equivalent. Leave blank if you do not have one.
settings.euVatNumberHint: Required on every invoice under VAT Directive Art. 226(3).
settings.vatCountryHint: The member state you are established in for VAT. This is the switch for the whole EU VAT engine — leave it blank and every order is taxed at its tax class’s own flat rate. Do not set it before you have checked the rate table below.
settings.gpsrEnforced: Require product safety information before publishing
settings.gpsrEnforcedHint: GPSR Art. 19. Refuses to publish a product with no manufacturer, no identifier or no safety warning — and, where the manufacturer is outside the EU, no responsible person inside it. Turn this on to sell into the EU. The same checks are reported on every product either way.
vatRates.title: EU VAT rates
vatRates.description: One rate per member state and band, with the date it starts. Rates are added, never edited.
vatRates.verifyTitle: Verify these before you invoice anything
vatRates.verifyBody: The seeded figures are a starting point so a new deployment can price something, not a live feed. Member states change rates with a few months’ notice and nothing here tracks that. Check them against the Commission’s published rates.
vatRates.inactiveTitle: EU VAT is not switched on
vatRates.inactiveBody: No VAT country is set on the business profile, so these rates are not used — every order is taxed at its tax class’s own flat rate. Set the VAT country above once you have checked this table.
vatRates.addHint: Correcting a rate means adding a period with a later start date. The old one keeps applying to everything already invoiced under it.
vatRates.startsOnHint: The date this rate begins applying.
vatRates.label: Label
vatRates.labelHint: Optional. Helps tell two reduced bands apart.
vatRates.emptyDescription: Run npm run db:reference to seed the twenty-seven member states, then check every rate you sell at.
vatRates.couldNotAdd: That rate period could not be added.
vatRates.couldNotClose: That period could not be closed.

processors.description: Read from this deployment’s configuration, not from a list anyone maintains.
processors.transfersBody: {{count}} active recipient(s) carrying personal data are established outside the EEA. Each needs a transfer mechanism under GDPR Arts. 44–49 and a mention in your privacy notice.
processors.limitsBody: Only integrations this software makes itself. A logging proxy, a managed database, a backup target or an error tracker are recipients too, and none of them are visible from here. "Where" is where the company is established, which is not always where the data is processed.
settings.vatBandHint: Which band this class falls in across the EU. Leave it unset and the flat rate above is used wherever the product is sold — correct for GST and for any shop not selling into the EU.
settings.noEuBand: No EU band — use the flat rate
operators.title: Manufacturers and responsible persons
operators.description: The companies named on product listings under EU product-safety law.
operators.whyBody: GPSR Art. 19 requires a listing to name the manufacturer, with a postal and an electronic address, before the product is offered online. Art. 16 requires a responsible person inside the Union whenever that manufacturer is established outside it. They live here rather than on each product because one manufacturer supplies dozens of listings.
operators.formHint: The name and both addresses appear on every listing that names this company.
operators.retireBody: {{name}} is named on {{count}} listing(s). Retiring is refused while any product still names it — a listing with no manufacturer named is the exact state GPSR Art. 19 forbids.
operators.legalNameHint: As it appears on the company register.
operators.tradeNameHint: Only if it differs from the registered name.
operators.countryCodeHint: Two-letter code. This decides whether an EU responsible person is required.
operators.emailHint: The manufacturer’s own address, not your support inbox. A buyer has to be able to reach them directly.
operators.eudamedSrnHint: MDR Art. 31. The Single Registration Number this manufacturer was issued when it registered in Eudamed. One number covers every device it puts on the market, which is why it lives here rather than on a product.
operators.emptyDescription: Add the manufacturers you buy from. A product cannot be published in the EU without one.
operators.couldNotSave: That company could not be saved.
operators.couldNotArchive: That company could not be retired.
productSafety.title: Product safety
productSafety.description: What GPSR Art. 19 requires a listing to carry before the product is offered online.
productSafety.complete: This listing carries everything Art. 19 requires.
productSafety.blocksPublication: This listing cannot be published yet
productSafety.notEnforcedBody: These do not block publication, because product-safety enforcement is switched off for this deployment. Turn it on under Settings once these are filled in.
productSafety.translationsBody: The safety warning has not been translated into: {{languages}}. Art. 19(d) asks for a language the buyer easily understands. This never blocks publication — it is a job for the translations tab.
productSafety.euResponsibleHint: Art. 16. Required only when the manufacturer is established outside the EU.
productSafety.modelHint: The manufacturer’s own type or model designation.
productSafety.gtinHint: 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits. Our SKU is not an identifier for this purpose.
productSafety.warningsHint: Art. 19(d). Shown on the product page before anyone buys. If the product genuinely carries no warnings, say so here rather than leaving it empty.
productSafety.instructionsHint: Handling and use, where they matter.

invoice.couldNotIssue: The invoice could not be raised.
invoice.noPermission: You do not have permission to raise an invoice.

invoice.couldNotCredit: The credit note could not be issued.
invoice.isCreditNote: This is a credit note reversing an earlier invoice.
invoice.noEditHint: There is no edit and no delete. A correction is always a credit note followed by a new invoice.
customerVat.title: EU VAT number
customerVat.description: What decides whether a cross-border sale to this customer is zero-rated.
customerVat.numberHint: Including the member state prefix, e.g. DE811569869.
customerVat.notZeroRated: Until a member state confirms this number, sales to this customer are charged VAT rather than zero-rated. The seller carries the liability for getting that wrong, so an unconfirmed number is treated as no number.
customerVat.refused: VIES does not recognise this number.
customerVat.unavailable: VIES could not be reached. The number stays unverified.
customerVat.couldNotCheck: The check could not be made.

customerVat.saveBeforeChecking: Save the number before checking it.
device.title: Medical device (MDR)
device.description: What a device listing must carry under Regulation (EU) 2017/745.
device.notADevice: This product is not marked as a medical device.
device.scopeTitle: This screen is not MDR compliance
device.scopeBody: MDR is a quality management system, a clinical evaluation, post-market surveillance and vigilance reporting. A catalogue holds none of that. What it holds — and what this panel edits — is the part a buyer and a market surveillance authority read off the listing.
device.complete: This listing carries the device information a buyer needs.
device.blocksPublication: This listing cannot be published yet
device.notEnforcedBody: These do not block publication, because device enforcement is switched off for this deployment. Turn it on under Settings once they are filled in.
device.translationsBody: The intended purpose has not been translated into: {{languages}}. This never blocks publication — it is a job for the translations tab.
device.classHint: Annex VIII. Plain Class I is self-certified; a sterile, measuring or reusable-surgical Class I is not, and everything from IIa upwards needs a notified body.
device.notifiedBodyHint: Four digits, as it appears beside the CE marking — e.g. 0123. Not the certificate number.
device.udiDiHint: Identifies this packaging configuration. This is the one on the label.
device.basicUdiDiHint: Identifies the device group. This is what the declaration of conformity and the Eudamed entry are filed against, and it does not appear on the label.
device.intendedPurposeHint: Art. 10(11), in the manufacturer’s own words. It is what decides the classification, and it is shown on the product page.
device.declarationHint: A link a buyer can open. Art. 14(2)(a) expects a distributor to have one.
device.isSterileHint: Sterility is certified by a notified body, which changes the class.
device.hasMeasuringFunctionHint: The metrological aspect is certified by a notified body, which changes the class.
device.isSingleUseHint: Reprocessing a single-use device is restricted under Art. 17.
device.containsBiologicalMaterial: Contains material of human or animal origin
device.removeBody: This product will stop being treated as a medical device and the class, identifiers and intended purpose are deleted. The storefront stops showing them.
device.couldNotRemove: The device record could not be removed.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.description: The places your stock is held. Every receipt, adjustment and reservation is recorded against one of these.
warehouses.emptyDescription: Add the first one and it becomes the default, which is where stock received without a warehouse named will land.
warehouses.unplacedCount_one: {{count}} warehouse has no position yet, so it is not drawn above. Edit it and add coordinates, or look them up from its address.
warehouses.unplacedCount_other: {{count}} warehouses have no position yet, so they are not drawn above. Edit them and add coordinates, or look them up from their addresses.
warehouses.coverage.title: Delivers to
warehouses.coverage.nearestBorderNote: The distance above is measured to this point, in a straight line.
warehouses.coverage.noneInRange: No other country is within {{km}} km of this warehouse.
warehouses.coverage.notPlaced: This warehouse has no coordinates yet, so its coverage cannot be measured. Add them on the warehouse, or look them up from its address.
warehouses.coverage.failed: The coverage could not be measured. Point at the warehouse again to retry.
warehouses.deleteBlockedDefault: The default warehouse cannot be deleted. Make another one the default first.
warehouses.deleteBlockedStock: This warehouse has stock records against it, so it cannot be deleted. Retire it instead and its history stays readable.
warehouses.retired: Warehouse retired. Its stock history stays on the record.
warehouses.couldNotSave: That warehouse could not be saved.
warehouses.deleteBody: {{name}} will be removed completely, and that cannot be undone. Deleting only works while nothing has ever been booked against this warehouse. If a stock movement, a reservation or a scheduled order names it, nothing is deleted and you are told what is in the way — retire it instead, which keeps all of its history readable.
warehouses.couldNotDelete: That warehouse could not be deleted.
warehouses.retireBody_one: {{name}} will stop being offered when stock is received or adjusted. Nothing is deleted — every movement ever recorded against it stays readable, and you can bring it back at any time. It still holds {{count}} unit, so this will be refused until the stock is moved or written off.
warehouses.retireBody_other: {{name}} will stop being offered when stock is received or adjusted. Nothing is deleted — every movement ever recorded against it stays readable, and you can bring it back at any time. It still holds {{count}} units, so this will be refused until the stock is moved or written off.
warehouses.retireBody_zero: {{name}} will stop being offered when stock is received or adjusted. Nothing is deleted — every movement ever recorded against it stays readable, and you can bring it back at any time.
warehouses.noTilesBody: Your warehouses are drawn in the right places relative to each other, but there is no map behind them because none is configured. Whoever runs this installation can add one — a map service through MAP_STYLE_URL or MAP_TILE_URL, or a Google Maps key. Nothing about your warehouses is sent anywhere until they do.
warehouses.mapEmptyBody: None of your warehouses has coordinates. Add them to a warehouse — by hand, or looked up from its address — and it will appear here.
warehouses.map.failed: The map could not be loaded. Everything about your warehouses is in the table below.
warehouses.map.authFailed: Google rejected this installation's Maps key, so the map cannot be drawn. Everything about your warehouses is in the table below. Whoever runs this installation needs to check the key: its HTTP referrer restriction has to allow this address, the Maps JavaScript API has to be enabled, and the project needs billing switched on.
warehouses.map.screenReaderNote_one: A map of {{count}} warehouse. Everything it shows is listed in the table below.
warehouses.map.screenReaderNote_other: A map of {{count}} warehouses. Everything they show is listed in the table below.
warehouses.form.hint: The code and the name identify the warehouse; the address is what goes on paperwork; the coordinates are what the map draws. Only the first two are required.
warehouses.form.codeHint: Short, and it appears on every stock movement recorded here. Stored in capitals.
warehouses.form.name: Name
warehouses.form.nameHint: What the people working there call it.
warehouses.form.addressHint: Optional, and free-form: this is read by people, not parsed. It is also what the address lookup below searches on.
warehouses.form.positionHint: Optional. A warehouse with no position works exactly like the others — it is simply listed under the map rather than drawn on it.
warehouses.form.coordinatesPaired: Fill in both the latitude and the longitude, or leave both empty.
warehouses.form.latitudeRange: Latitude has to be a number between -90 and 90.
warehouses.form.longitudeRange: Longitude has to be a number between -180 and 180.
warehouses.form.lookUpNeedsAddress: Fill in some of the address first.
warehouses.form.lookupFound: Coordinates filled in. Check them before saving.
warehouses.form.lookupFoundLabel: Found {{place}}. Check the coordinates before saving.
warehouses.form.lookupNothing: Nothing was found for that address. Type the coordinates instead, or leave them empty.
warehouses.form.lookupFailed: The lookup could not be completed. Type the coordinates instead, or leave them empty.
warehouses.form.previewHint: Where this warehouse will be drawn. Check it before saving.
warehouses.form.isDefaultHint: Stock received without a warehouse named lands in the default. Choosing this one takes that role away from whichever warehouse holds it now.
warehouses.form.isDefaultAlready: This is already the default. To change it, open another warehouse and make that one the default instead — the default can never be left empty.
warehouses.noMatchDescription: Nothing here matches the search and filters above. Clear them to see every warehouse again.
warehouses.mapNoMatchBody: No warehouse matches the search and filters above, so there is nothing to draw.
warehouses.invalidCoordinatesBody_one: {{count}} warehouse ({{codes}}) has coordinates stored that are not a real position, so it is left off the map rather than drawn somewhere wrong. Edit it and enter the coordinates again, or clear both fields. This cannot happen through this panel — the values were written directly to the database or by an import.
warehouses.invalidCoordinatesBody_other: {{count}} warehouses ({{codes}}) have coordinates stored that are not a real position, so they are left off the map rather than drawn somewhere wrong. Edit them and enter the coordinates again, or clear both fields. This cannot happen through this panel — the values were written directly to the database or by an import.
warehouses.detail.positionInvalid: Stored, but not a real position
warehouses.form.countryHint: Chosen from the countries this deployment carries. It decides nothing about tax on its own — it is where the building is.
warehouses.form.countryRequired: Choose the country this warehouse is in.
warehouses.form.timezoneHint: An IANA name, such as Europe/Brussels. Used to show the local time at this warehouse — the country cannot be relied on, because some span two zones.
warehouses.form.operationalStatusHint: Whether this warehouse can ship today. Separate from retiring it, which is about whether it is part of the business at all.
warehouses.form.erpHint: Optional. Only the identifier is set here — whether the last sync worked, and when it ran, is written by whatever does the syncing and can never be typed in.

erp.savedRunTestBeforeActivating: Saved. Run a test before switching it on.
erp.savingReturnsToDraft: Saving puts the connection back to Draft, so it has to be tested again.

erp.form.name: Name
erp.form.baseUrlHint: The root of the ERP's API, over HTTPS. Every endpoint below is read relative to it.
erp.form.timeoutHint: How long to wait for a reply before treating the call as failed.
erp.form.secretsAreHidden: Stored secrets are never shown. Leave a box blank to keep what is saved.
erp.form.headerNameHint: Which header the key travels in. Not a secret.
erp.form.tokenUrlHint: Where to exchange the client credentials for an access token.
erp.form.scopeHint: Optional. Space-separated, as the ERP defines them.
erp.form.endpointsDescription: Paths on the ERP, relative to the base address. Leave one blank if the ERP does not offer it.
erp.form.fieldMappingDescription: Where each figure sits in the ERP's own reply. Written as a path, so a nested reply needs no code change.
erp.form.itemsPathHint: The path to the list itself. Leave blank if the reply is a plain array.
erp.form.automation: What it does on its own
erp.form.automationDescription: Which traffic flows once the connection is active.
erp.form.sendOrdersHint: Every paid order is pushed once, with a key that stops a retry creating a second one.
erp.form.useWebhooks: Let the ERP push stock changes here
erp.form.useWebhooksHint: The ERP calls the address below whenever a figure changes. Faster than checking on a schedule.
erp.form.signingSecretHint: Shared with the ERP. A call is rejected unless it is signed with this.
erp.form.signatureHeaderHint: Which header the ERP puts the signature in.
erp.form.checkOnSchedule: Check for stock changes on a schedule
erp.form.checkOnScheduleHint: A fallback for whatever the webhooks miss. Safe to leave on alongside them.
erp.form.authorityHint: When the ERP and UBOSS disagree about a quantity, this decides which one is believed.
erp.form.allowManualOverride: Allow a figure to be set by hand
erp.form.allowManualOverrideHint: Lets somebody fix one line without changing which side is believed for the rest.
erp.testChangesNothing: A test and a dry run only read. Neither creates an order nor changes a stock figure.
erp.beforeSwitchingOn: Before this can be switched on
erp.webhookUrl: Address for the ERP to call
erp.webhookUrlDescription: Paste this into the ERP's own webhook settings, along with the signing secret.
erp.mappingDoesNotMatch: The mapping does not match the data
erp.stockFromErp: Stock, as the ERP last reported it
erp.stockFromErpDescription: A record of what was received. Stock the shop sells from is still the movement ledger under Inventory.
erp.stockIsAReportTitle: This never moves stock by itself
erp.stockIsAReportBody: What the ERP sends is stored as a report. Stock the shop sells from is only ever changed through Inventory, where every movement has a reason and a person against it.
erp.noStockYetHint: Run a sync once the connection is active.
erp.activityDescription: Every call to and from the ERP, with what came back. Credentials are never recorded.
erp.thatCouldNotBeRetried: That could not be tried again.
erp.deleteConnectionDescription: Removes the connection, its credentials and the stock it reported. Orders already sent to the ERP are unaffected.
theme.label: Appearance
locale.notAChoice: Resolved from where this sign-in was made, and not editable here: the prices you check have to be the ones a customer in front of you actually pays.
warehouses.detail.radiusDefaultNote: Nobody has set a radius for this warehouse, so the deployment's default applies. Edit the warehouse to give it one of its own.
warehouses.detail.leadTimeUnsetNote: A warehouse with no delivery time recorded is not offered to a buyer choosing between warehouses, because there would be nothing to promise them.
warehouses.detail.excludedNone: None. Everything inside the radius is offered.
warehouses.coverage.radiusFromRequest: A radius you are trying out
warehouses.coverage.excludedNote: Inside the radius, and closed by you. A buyer here is not offered this warehouse.
warehouses.coverage.dormantTitle: Closed, and out of range anyway
warehouses.coverage.dormantNote: You have closed these countries on this warehouse, and the radius does not reach them. They are kept because a radius can grow.
warehouses.form.deliveryHint: How far this warehouse delivers, how long it takes and what it costs. The radius is measured against real country boundaries, so what it reaches is a fact rather than a guess, and closing a country is how you say you will not serve one it reaches.
warehouses.form.deliveryRadiusHint: Leave this empty to use the deployment's default of {{km}} km. A number here is this warehouse's own promise.
warehouses.form.deliveryRadiusRange: A delivery radius has to be a whole number of kilometres between 1 and 2000.
warehouses.form.leadTimeHint: A range, because a single figure is either a promise that gets broken or a padded one that loses the sale. Leave both empty and this warehouse is not offered to a buyer choosing between warehouses.
warehouses.form.leadTimePaired: Fill in both the fastest and the slowest time, or leave both empty.
warehouses.form.leadTimeOrder: The fastest time cannot be slower than the slowest one.
warehouses.form.leadTimeRange: A delivery time has to be a whole number of days between 0 and 365.
warehouses.form.deliveryFeeHint: What this warehouse charges to deliver, in the currency you choose. Zero is a real answer: it means free from here. Leave it empty if delivery from this warehouse has not been priced.
warehouses.form.deliveryFeeInvalid: A delivery fee has to be an amount like 12.50, and cannot be negative.
warehouses.form.deliveryFeeCurrencyRequi: Choose the currency the fee is in.
warehouses.form.excludedLegend: Countries this warehouse will not deliver to
warehouses.form.excludedHint: The radius decides what this warehouse can reach; this decides what it will serve. A country closed here stays closed if the radius grows later, and a buyer there is never offered this warehouse.
warehouses.form.excludedNone: No country is closed. Everything inside the radius is offered.
warehouseInventory.title: {{name}} inventory
warehouseInventory.description: Every product in the catalogue, and what this warehouse ({{code}}) holds of each. A product with no stock here is still listed: an absence you cannot see is an absence you cannot act on.
warehouseInventory.emptyDescription: No product matches the search and the filter above. Clear them to see the whole catalogue again.
warehouseInventory.retiredNote: This warehouse is retired. Its stock is still standing in a building and still counted here, and it is no longer offered when stock is received or adjusted.
warehouseInventory.unstockedNote_one: {{count}} SKU in the catalogue has never had stock booked at this warehouse. That is different from being out of stock: nothing has ever arrived here.
warehouseInventory.unstockedNote_other: {{count}} SKUs in the catalogue have never had stock booked at this warehouse. That is different from being out of stock: nothing has ever arrived here.
sellerWarehouses.pickerHint: Search the approved seller companies. Only businesses whose onboarding has been approved can be chosen here.
sellerWarehouses.searchFailed: The companies could not be loaded.
sellerWarehouses.noCompaniesHint: Only businesses whose seller onboarding has been approved appear here. An application still in review, or a seller that has been stopped, will not.
sellerWarehouses.moreCompanies: Showing the first {{count}}. Keep typing to narrow it.
sellerWarehouses.chooseDescription: Search above for an approved seller, and their dispatch locations will appear on the map and in the table.
sellerWarehouses.unavailableDescription: It may have been stopped since this link was made, or its application was never approved. Choose another company.
sellerWarehouses.noneTitle: This seller has no dispatch locations
sellerWarehouses.noneDescription: They have not added a warehouse yet, or every one of theirs is closed. Turn on “Include closed” to see the closed ones.
sellerWarehouses.noneAnywhereTitle: No seller has a dispatch location yet
sellerWarehouses.noneAnywhereDescription: Approved sellers appear here as soon as they add somewhere to dispatch from.
sellerWarehouses.loadFailed: The warehouses could not be loaded.
sellerWarehouses.truncatedBody: More matched than this screen can draw at once. Narrow it by country, or choose one company.
sellerWarehouses.unplacedNote: {{count}} of these have no position and are not on the map.
sellerWarehouses.brokenNote: {{count}} have a position that cannot be plotted.
productSource.packagingIntro: How this is boxed, as the catalogue import read it. The customer sees everything here except the sticker artwork size. To correct any of it, correct the source sheet and import it again — an edit here would be overwritten by the next run.
productSource.heading: Source record
productSource.internalOnly: Internal. None of this is shown to a customer — it is on its own table so it cannot reach the storefront by accident.
productDetail.priceOnRequestHint: The price is negotiated per account. The storefront invites a quotation instead of showing a figure, nothing can be added to a cart, and the product can be published without a price.
productDetail.orderableHint: Turn this off to keep the listing and its specifications readable while refusing every purchase. Unpublishing hides the product completely; this does not.
productDetail.unavailabilityReasonHint: Shown to the customer beside the notice. Leave it blank for the notice on its own.
productDetail.provisionalPrice: This price is a placeholder, set when the catalogue was imported without prices. A customer can order at it. Save a real price above to confirm it — doing so clears this notice.
logistics.offerReason.NO_COVERAGE_ORIGIN: Does not collect where this starts
logistics.offerReason.NO_COVERAGE_DESTIN: Does not deliver where this is going
logistics.offerReason.AT_CAPACITY: Already at its limit of open consignments
logistics.shipmentStatus.ACCEPTANCE_PEND: Waiting for the carrier to accept
logistics.partners.heading: Carriers
logistics.partners.intro: The haulage companies this marketplace uses. Nobody signs themselves up: a carrier exists because somebody here created it and invited its first owner.
logistics.partners.addIntro: Create the company, then invite the person who will run it. They receive a link that lets them set their own password and second factor.
logistics.partners.searchPlaceholder: Trading name, registered name or code
logistics.partners.emptyBody: Add the first haulage company and invite whoever will run its account.
logistics.partners.ownerHint: They become the owner of the carrier account and can invite the rest of their team themselves.
logistics.partners.field.countryHint: Two letters, such as DE or PL.
logistics.partners.field.internalNotesHi: Only people in this console can read it. The carrier never sees it.
logistics.partners.invited.title: Invitation sent
logistics.partners.invited.body: A link has been emailed to {{email}}.
logistics.partners.invited.expires: It works once and stops working on {{date}}.
logistics.partners.invited.noPassword: No password was created and none was emailed. They choose their own, and set up a second factor before they can do anything.
logistics.partners.invited.notSignedIn: Nobody here is signed in as this carrier. They sign in on the logistics portal with the account they have just been sent.
logistics.partner.changeStatusIntro: Suspending or closing a carrier stops any new work reaching them. Work they have already accepted is theirs to finish.
logistics.partner.statusChangedWithdrew: Status changed. {{withdrawn}} consignments were taken back so another carrier can be found.
logistics.partner.reasonRequired: Required when suspending or closing. The carrier sees it.
logistics.partner.handover: Take back work they have not accepted yet
logistics.partner.handoverHint: Anything still waiting for their answer goes back in the queue for another carrier. Consignments they have already accepted are not touched.
logistics.partner.noIntegration: None — statuses come from their own staff
logistics.partner.capabilitiesIntro: Approving one of these is what lets a consignment with that requirement be offered to this carrier at all. Cold chain, sterile handling and dangerous goods are safety decisions.
logistics.partner.noCapabilitiesBody: Nothing is approved yet, so this carrier is only offered consignments that need no special handling. Add one once the evidence has been checked.
logistics.partner.addCapabilityIntro: What this carrier may carry, and the evidence checked before deciding.
logistics.partner.field.capabilityDecisi: Approved lets consignments needing it reach them. Asked for records the request without granting it.
logistics.partner.field.evidenceReferenc: The certificate or licence number checked. Optional.
logistics.partner.field.evidenceExpiresA: Leave blank if it does not expire.
logistics.partner.field.capabilityNoteHi: Why it was decided this way. It is kept with the decision.
logistics.partner.regionsIntro: A consignment is only offered to this carrier when both ends of its journey fall inside one of these.
logistics.partner.addRegionIntro: Saving replaces the whole list, so removing one here removes it everywhere.
logistics.partner.noRegionsBody: Until an area is added, this carrier will not be offered anything.
logistics.partner.field.regionValueHint: The city, region or postcode area, spelled as the carrier would.
logistics.partner.slaIntro: How long this carrier has to collect and to deliver, and what proof a delivery needs. A consignment is measured against the promise that applies to its service.
logistics.partner.slaDialogIntro: Hours are counted from the moment the carrier accepts. Leave one blank to make no promise about it.
logistics.partner.noSlaBody: Without one, nothing this carrier holds is measured for lateness.
logistics.partner.field.riskWindowHint: How long before the deadline a consignment starts showing as at risk.
logistics.partner.podLegend: What a delivery has to record
logistics.partner.podHint: The driver cannot mark a consignment delivered until everything ticked here has been captured.
logistics.partner.pod.otp: A one-time code from the recipient
logistics.partner.makeDefault: Use this when nothing more specific applies
logistics.partner.makeDefaultHint: Only one promise per carrier can be the default.
logistics.partner.peopleIntro: Everybody at this carrier who can sign in. Owners and administrators must set up a second factor before they can do anything.
logistics.fleet.heading: Drivers and vehicles
logistics.fleet.intro: The carrier's own fleet. Anything added here appears in their portal too — it is one register, not a copy.
logistics.fleet.addDriverHint: Type the name. No account is needed — most of a fleet never signs in here.
logistics.fleet.addVehicleHint: Registration and type are enough. The rest helps match a vehicle to what it can carry.
logistics.fleet.noDriversBody: This carrier has nobody on its fleet. Add one here if they have asked you to.
logistics.fleet.driverNameHint: As it should read on the delivery record.
logistics.partner.inviteIntro: They receive a link that works once. No password is created here and none is emailed.
logistics.partner.noPeopleBody: Invite the person who will run this carrier account.
logistics.partner.field.roleHint: A driver sees only their own round. Tracking-only can look and nothing else.
logistics.shipments.heading: Consignments
logistics.shipments.intro: Every consignment, whoever is carrying it. The ones waiting for a carrier are the only rows here that need somebody in this console to act.
logistics.shipments.searchPlaceholder: Reference, tracking number or receiving company
logistics.shipments.emptyUnassigned: Every consignment has a carrier. Nothing is waiting.
logistics.shipment.subtitle: {{seller}} to {{receiver}}
logistics.shipment.handling: How this has to be handled
logistics.shipment.staleFeed: Nothing has come from the carrier since {{when}}. What is shown below is the last thing they told us, not a live position.
logistics.shipment.noConnection: None — statuses come from people, not an API
logistics.shipment.assignments: Who it has been offered to
logistics.shipment.noAssignmentsBody: Offer it to a carrier to get it moving.
logistics.shipment.noEventsBody: Every status change will be listed here as it happens.
logistics.shipment.assignIntro: Carriers are scored on where they operate, what they are approved to carry, how much they already have on, and how often they deliver on time. The reasons are shown against each one.
logistics.shipment.noCarriersBody: Nobody active covers both ends of this journey with the capabilities it needs. Add an area or approve a capability on a carrier, then try again.
logistics.shipment.offered: Offered. The carrier has been told.
logistics.shipment.withdrawIntro: The carrier loses access to this consignment and it goes back in the queue. They see the reason.
logistics.shipment.withdrawReasonHint: At least four characters. The carrier reads this.
logistics.shipment.correctIntro: For putting right a status that was recorded wrongly. This is the only way to move a consignment out of delivered, returned, lost or cancelled.
logistics.shipment.correctWarning: The correction is written into the history and stays there. Anybody reading this consignment months from now will see that it was corrected, by whom, and why.
logistics.shipment.correctReasonHint: At least eight characters. It becomes part of the record.
logistics.exceptions.heading: Delivery problems
logistics.exceptions.intro: Everything that has gone wrong and is not sorted out yet, worst first and then oldest first.
logistics.exceptions.emptyOpen: No consignment has an open problem right now.
logistics.integrations.heading: Carrier connections
logistics.integrations.intro: How this deployment talks to each carrier. A connection with no credentials says so plainly and carries nothing — no consignment is sent to it and nothing is reported as booked with it.
logistics.integrations.credentialsPolicy: Carrier keys are read from environment variables or your secrets manager and stored encrypted. Nothing in this console will ever show you one back, and a webhook signing secret is shown once, when it is created.
logistics.integrations.addIntro: Name the connection and pick the carrier it talks to. Credentials are added to the environment afterwards, not typed here.
logistics.integrations.emptyBody: Carriers can still be used without one: their staff record every status themselves in their own portal.
logistics.integrations.notConfiguredBody: No credentials are stored for this carrier, so nothing is sent to them and nothing comes back. Set these in the environment and test again:
logistics.integrations.failingSince: {{failures}} failures in a row. The last one was on {{when}}.
logistics.integrations.field.baseUrlHint: Leave blank to use the carrier’s own default.
logistics.integrations.field.pollingHint: For carriers that do not push. Leave off where they send a feed.
logistics.integrations.field.name: Name it
logistics.integrations.secretMissing: Not set — signed posts will be refused
logistics.integrations.requiresNothing: Nothing to configure. Their staff record every status in the carrier portal.
logistics.integrations.credentialsAfterw: The connection can be created now, but it stays unconfigured and carries nothing until these are set in the environment:
logistics.integrations.mapIntro: Every carrier has its own vocabulary. This is where one of their codes is given a meaning here. A code nobody has mapped is kept whole and queued, never dropped.
logistics.integrations.field.providerCod: Exactly as it arrives in their feed.
logistics.integrations.field.mapsToHint: Leave unset to ignore the code entirely.
logistics.integrations.field.publicDescr: The line a customer reads on the tracking page. Leave blank to use ours.
logistics.integrations.noKnownCodes: None. Every code from this carrier has to be mapped by hand.

logistics.shipments.carrierHasNoDrivers: This carrier has nobody on its fleet yet. Add a driver on the carrier page.

operations.platformOperationsDescription: Everything waiting for somebody, in the queues you can act on. Choose a slice to ask about that group on its own.
operations.allClear: Nothing is waiting in any queue you can act on.
operations.remainder: {{count}} items are not shown in this chart.
operations.clampNote: Slices below one per cent are drawn at a readable minimum. The figures beside them are exact.
operations.ai.q1: Which operational queue needs attention first?
operations.ai.q2: Which seller approvals are waiting the longest?

aiInsights.askLabel: Ask a question about this dashboard
aiInsights.askFailed: That did not work. Try again.
aiInsights.disclosure: Answers are generated. Every figure comes from your own data, never from the model.
aiInsights.deterministic: No AI provider is configured on this installation, so this summary was built directly from your figures.
aiInsights.unavailable: The AI provider could not be reached, so this summary was built directly from your figures.
aiInsights.idle: Ask a question about the figures on this page, or choose Explain this chart.

variantMatrix.title: Variant builder
variantMatrix.description: The dimensions products on the {{shelf}} shelf are usually sold along. Switch on only the ones this product really varies by.
variantMatrix.chooseAxes: What does this product vary by?
variantMatrix.chooseAxesHint: Each one you switch on becomes a choice the buyer makes, and every combination becomes its own SKU with its own price and stock.
variantMatrix.addValuePlaceholder: Type a value and press Enter
variantMatrix.skuPrefixHint: Optional. Goes in front of the product code.
variantMatrix.bulkPriceHint: Minor units. Leave blank to inherit the product price.
variantMatrix.bulkMoq: Minimum order for every new row
variantMatrix.bulkMoqHint: Leave blank to use the product's own minimum.
variantMatrix.largeTable: {{total}} rows is a large table. Check every price and stock figure before saving.
variantMatrix.nothingToCreateHint: Every combination in this table already exists.
variantMatrix.couldNotSaveAxes: Those dimensions could not be saved.
variantMatrix.couldNotPreview: The table could not be worked out.
variantMatrix.couldNotGenerate: The variants could not be created.
auth.login.staffAccountsAreCreated: Staff accounts are created by an administrator. Ask whoever runs this deployment to invite you, and the invitation arrives by email.
